action_postprocess: policy postprocessor (unnormalizer), float32, no clipping (as lerobot-eval rollout)
noise: per (eval_seed, item): torch.Generator('cpu').manual_seed(derive_seed('libero-noise', eval_seed, item)); one standard-normal float32 draw of shape (1, chunk_size, max_action_dim) per environment step, passed as select_action(noise=...), which uses it when the action queue is empty (policies/smolvla/modeling_smolvla.py:256-285, :790-794); torch global RNG reseeded with derive_seed('libero-torch', eval_seed, item) before the episode

observation.canonicalization: lerobot.sim.integrations.libero.canonical_observation (images rotated 180 degrees; state = eef pos, axis-angle, gripper qpos, 8-D)
